facts.fact: Techsoma reports the federal Government Service Portal (services.gov.ng) uses single sign-on with the National Identification Number or verified business credentials, during a current pilot phase.

NGA.note: Document says nothing on links between civil register and ID.
Document mentions business credentials for sign-in only; no business register stated.

facts.fact: Techsoma reports the Federal Government launched the Government Service Portal at services.gov.ng, giving citizens and businesses online access to services from various ministries, still in a pilot phase with more agencies to be onboarded.

NGA.note: No count of ministries or services, no usage figures; the 88% and 71% figures are pilot tester results, not use.
No enrolment count or share stated.
Nothing on a number at birth.
Nothing on who operates or owns the ID system.
A portal sign-in by NIN is not a public register keyed on the number.
Nothing on the ID system's issuance, biometrics or certification.
